prompt:
Image 1 is the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge of a room. Edit it into the same view of the same room at this time of day: Day. Keep the camera position, framing, lens, walls, doors, windows, furniture, materials and colours exactly as in Image 1; change only the light. Outside every window and doorway, show what that place looks like at Day, with the sky, light and lit windows of that time, never the daylight scene of Image 1 darkened. Inside, light the room as the description says it is lit at that time, with only the lamps it names turned on. The place stays completely empty of people: no person, figure, silhouette or reflection of a person anywhere. Location: JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM. Grand living room of a contemporary luxury mansion, seen five years earlier. The floors are polished cream marble, white marble columns stand along one side and a wall runs behind them. A long beige sofa faces a low marble-and-gold coffee table on a thick ivory carpet. Tall French windows look out on garden trees whose leaves sway in warm sunlight. Golden afternoon sun streams through the windows from the right, casting warm leaf-dappled light. A crystal chandelier hangs overhead.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, a darkened copy of Image 1's daylight, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
